items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I don't know if he had played with him. I really don't know, Bill.

ctx.x: Can you tell us which bands he played with?
Oh no, no, no, no. I don't know if he had played with him. I really don't know, Bill.
How old were you when he died? He's dead now, I guess.
